lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No. 7,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: there's been something on my mind the past few days.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Would you care to listen?
Have you had trouble finding a willing test subject?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That is indeed one of my concerns, yes,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: but this is something much bigger than that.
What is it?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It's my glasses.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: The ones I wear whenever I conduct an experiment.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Whenever I get too focused, the lenses keep fogging up.
What in the world am I listening to?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Once that happens, all my focus goes right out the window,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: and I don't want to do anything.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So, as you can imagine, it's a real conundrum.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Do you think there's any way to stop my lenses from fogging up?
Use contact lenses.
Take off your glasses.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No, I can't do that.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: My glasses are part of my identity.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I can't just toss them to the side.
Why don't you create a substance that prevents your lenses from fogging up?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That's not my area of expertise.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Although...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: What if there's no steam coming off of my breath?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I might be onto something here.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Thanks for the advice, No. 7!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: If I ever bring this experiment to trial,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'll be sure to use you as a test subject :)
No, wait...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I've gotta get back to work on my project.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Take it easy.
I pray that Ether is only joking.
